title: Wes C
content: My wife, soulmate, best friend, and everything to me, died in February 2025 in a tragic car accident just five minutes from home. I was out of town that day and woke up to a news article about her accident. The last time I spoke with her was 20 minutes before it happened, while I was out drinking with a friend at a bar. I completely lost myself that day. Fifteen years together, all gone in the blink of an eye. I spent two weeks by her side in the ICU, where she laid on the bed with a severe brain injury. After countless surgeries, authorizing the withdrawal of life support, and watching her take her last breaths, she was gone. I’m not sure what to call the experience, but one night I bought opioid medication from someone I knew and took several pills with copious amounts of alcohol. That night, I had several episodes where my breathing stopped (respiratory depression), and I could feel myself drifting off somewhere. Suddenly, I felt a strange sensation of lifting out of my body and hovering above myself in my bedroom. Everything looked exactly the same, despite my eyes being closed and being unconscious. I floated through my bedroom door and flew around my living room, which was an amazing feeling. I felt weightless, unbound by my physical body, and completely sober. I floated back into my bedroom, sank into my mattress, and felt myself merge with it. It was as if my essence blended with the atoms of the material, and we were just connected. I sensed a presence in the room behind me and turned my vision toward the side of the bed. A figure began to appear, starting with the feet, then the calves, then the thighs. A sense of fear came over me. When the head appeared, it looked terrifying, like a demon or something from a horror movie. I quickly prayed to Jesus, saying, "Please help me." Suddenly, the face changed, filled with light, and it was Jesus! He looked different from how I’d seen him in church or on TV. His hair was shorter and curly; and he had an incredible smile. He wore a robe and seemed surrounded by an aura of light. He winked at me, and a little butterfly flew off his shoulder toward me. My sweet, deceased wife was riding on the butterfly’s wing, smiling at me with the happiest expression I’d ever seen. The moment I saw her face, I woke up gasping for air. I’ll never know how close I was to dying since I was alone at home. But the combination of opioids, sleep apnea, and alcohol was dangerous. Still, I’m grateful for that experience because it gives me hope that my beautiful wife is with Jesus, waiting to take me on the ride of my life when my time comes.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain, Suicide attempt, Drug or medication overdose, Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I was overdosed on opiates and drunk on alcohol when I entered my OBE, and was completely sober and alert during the experience.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I was out of my body during the entire OBE.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, There was no sense of time in this experience.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I did not seem to hear much. It was all visual, knowing, and awareness.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt fear in the beginning, and then immense happiness after seeing Jesus and my deceased wife.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I was raised Christian but always had doubts that there is anything after this life.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, Jesus Christ.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, I felt connected to everything when I was out of my body.

Yes, After leaving my body and seeing everything in my apartment as if I were awake. This happened while I was intoxicated and experiencing a drug overdose. The only conclusion I can make is that there is more to the physical. Also seeing Jesus and my deceased wife.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I have hope that I will be reunited with my wife again in the afterlife. I no longer fear death but welcome it.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I tend to forget dreams, but this was a completely different experience; especially since I my body was in an overdose and intoxicated state. Yet, the experience was sober, lucid, and meaningful.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: After listening to Dr. Eben Alexander's NDE where he talks about his deceased sister riding on the wing of a butterfly, my OBE seems to be valid and extremely meaningful. At first I couldn't explain it.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, I had knowledge of NDEs, but it did not affect the experience. I'm not sure if it was an OBE or an NDE.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was probably real, It felt more real than this life.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes, Listening to Dr. Eben Alexander's NDE account after my experience validated it.
